theorem witness_asid : ¬ type_of% @reachable_mutable_isolation := by
  intro h
  have := h 1 0 wSpaces [.alloc .user 0, .map 1 0 wH wRU, .map 2 0 wH wRWU] (by decide)
    ⟨1, 0, 0, wRU, 2⟩ (by decide) ⟨2, 0, 0, wRWU, 2⟩ (by decide) ⟨1, true⟩ ⟨2, true⟩
    (by decide) (by decide) rfl rfl rfl (by decide)
  exact absurd this.2 (by decide)

theorem witness_no_last_asid : ¬ type_of% @reachable_coherent := by
  intro h

  obtain ⟨a, ha, _⟩ := hc.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 ⟨1, 0, 0, wRU, 2⟩ (by decide) ⟨1, true⟩ (by decide) rfl
